samples.description: Here's an example of a request for retrieving a list of product (not descriped in the UC part). The given criteria is the billing account id (BA1236).
Here's an example of a request for retrieving a product (based on a Product Specification). The given criteria is the product id g265-tf85.
Here's an example of a request for retrieving a product (based on a Product Offering). The given criteria is the product.id 45hj-df54-yui9.
Here's an example of a request for creating a product for use case 1 - the resulting product is g265-tf85.
Here's an example of a request for updating a product (using previous product created) using json-patch - Change value for speed + user contact.
Here's an example of a request for updating a product (using previous product created) using merge-patch  - Change value for speed + user contact.
Here's an example of a request for deleting a product.
